context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:22 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose another option.
Based on (ruling): your 12:54 CST ruling: a run cut at its time limit counts as a sample and raises the limit, so a short job cut once heals on its next run.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — the work it governs follows this pick.

options.gain: A short job is never cut by a tiny limit, and the floor moves with the data.
options.how: A very short job's limit is never below the median of all computed limits; no fixed number is stored.
options.label: The middle of all limits (Recommended)
options.lose: A short job that hangs runs longer before it is stopped.

options.how: A very short job keeps its own computed limit; a slow run turns red once, then the limit heals.
options.label: No floor
options.lose: One red run per short job.

options.how: You give a number of minutes, and it becomes the floor.
options.label: You name a floor
options.lose: A fixed number that can go stale.

reply: Closed: you kept the pick; a short job's limit is never below the median of all limits.
short: Lowest CI time limit for a very short job
